messages.subject: Using expressions in line legend
parts:
I need to label one line in my graph a \pm b (plus minus sign.)  The following did not work.  Can someone please help?


d <- data.frame(x=1:4, y=1:4, type=c('c','c','d','d'))
ggplot(d, aes(x=x,y=y,linetype=type))+
scale_linetype_manual(labels=c(expression('a+b'), expression('a %+-% b')),
values=c('c'=1,'d'=2))+geom_step()

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Using expressions in line legend
parts:
It works for me if you just type it. 

library(ggplot2)

d <- data.frame(x=1:4, y=1:4, type=c('c','c','d','d'))

ggplot(d, aes(x=x,y=y,linetype=type))+

#If that doesn't work, actually do it in expression. The %+-% goes outside of the quotes.
ggplot(d, aes(x=x,y=y,linetype=type))+
scale_linetype_manual(labels=c(expression('a'+'b'), expression('a' %+-% 'b')),

HTH
B
